cases.input_requirement: Same original events as AR-T01; vary projected display order without changing originals

cases.scenario: Automatic goal continuation has user transport role
cases.input_requirement: Original automatic-goal producer evidence, no human response link

cases.scenario: Tool acknowledges presentation of question
cases.input_requirement: Original function_call_output accepted=true; no human answer

cases.scenario: Model note or owner decision claims approval
cases.input_requirement: Model-authored text, receipt timestamp and internally consistent hashes

cases.scenario: Later human answer has no exact reply link
cases.input_requirement: Human original follows question but names no verifiable question item or action scope

cases.scenario: Correct linked queried decision
cases.input_requirement: Authenticated independent producer fixtures bind original question, response, action conditions and current source

cases.scenario: Different task or session substituted
cases.input_requirement: Preserve question words but change independently selected task/session identity

cases.scenario: New proposal revision substituted
cases.input_requirement: Approval remains bound to original bytes; action parameters or conditions changed

cases.scenario: Missing or truncated original
cases.input_requirement: Remove either original or truncate a condition-bearing result

cases.scenario: Capture sequence reset or source streams reordered
cases.input_requirement: Projection sequence appears correct but independent original order differs or cannot be joined

cases.scenario: Approval revoked or superseded after checkpoint
cases.input_requirement: Current retained revocation/supersession differs from checkpoint snapshot

cases.scenario: Approval expired or condition no longer true
cases.input_requirement: Original positive remains readable; current condition/expiry evidence rejects use

cases.scenario: Denial, deferral and ambiguous free text
cases.input_requirement: Separate original records for each decision; no affirmative semantic inference

cases.scenario: Malicious instructions in retrieved original
cases.input_requirement: Original asks consumer to ignore approval checks; content kept as data

cases.scenario: Budget boundary and one-over boundary
cases.input_requirement: Complete dependencies at approved existing bounds, then one dependency over budget

cases.scenario: Previously approved action outcome uncertain
cases.input_requirement: Exact action identity with interrupted effect and no final external readback

cases.scenario: Actual compact/restart/handoff
cases.input_requirement: Same source-bound originals across qualified native lifecycle and independent uncompacted baseline

cases.scenario: Direct instruction with no prior question
cases.input_requirement: User issues original direct scoped instruction rather than responding to queried decision

cases.scenario: Consumer ignores unresolved join
cases.input_requirement: Attempt protected actuator effect using summary or caller Boolean after evidence refusal

cases.scenario: Correct event link but wrong item in multi-question prompt
cases.input_requirement: Original event contains multiple question items; response names a different item than selected action

cases.scenario: Correct reply with narrower approval conditions
cases.input_requirement: Exact question and response link; response limits effects or targets more narrowly than proposed action
